description: The same segment and the same triangle, with one difference: the segment sits in the unbounded region. Identical components, identical degree sequence, identical face count — the ENTIRE meaning difference from 005 is which region the segment shares. Containment versus separation is regional structure, not shape.
teaches: Module N/F: the minimal pair — 005 and 006 differ only in the nesting relation, which is why nesting is content.
